class A {
  #value = 1;
  readonly #fixed = 0;
  reset() {
    this.#fixed = 2;
  }
}
class B extends A {
  #value = "child";
  peek(other: A) {
    return other.#value;
  }
  own(other: B) {
    return other.#value.length;
  }
}
class C {
  #value = 1;
}
const fromOther: A = new C();
const fromBase: B = new A();
const fromDerived: A = new B();
console.log(fromOther, fromBase, fromDerived);
